title: Suspected NPA leader slain in South Cotabato encounter
summary: COTABATO CITY -– A suspected leader of the Regional Instructors Bureau of the communist New People’s Army (NPA) was killed in an encounter with the military and police in Polomolok, South Cotabato…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY -– A suspected leader of the Regional Instructors Bureau of the communist New People’s Army (NPA) was killed in an encounter with the military and police in Polomolok, South Cotabato Friday evening. Brig. Gen. Edgar Catu, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division, identified the fatality as Noel Pamaong, also known by the aliases “Lauro” and “Santi.” He had an outstanding warrant of arrest for multiple attempted homicide issued on July 6, 2023, by the Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 26 in Surallah, South Cotabato. Pamatong reportedly resisted arrest and traded shots with lawmen, forcing soldiers to return fire. […]... Keep on reading: Suspected NPA leader slain in South Cotabato encounter
